\section{Catcodes}
% [T1] a \makeatletter pair in the body
\makeatletter Local text: \gm@localtext. \makeatother
% [T10] the class macro runs \makeatletter before reading its arguments, so
% \gm@one is one control sequence here even though @ is not a letter
Columns: \gmcolumncase{\gm@one}{\gm@two}.
% [T15] an active " switched on inside a group by a macro
{\gmdqon M"uller, Sch"one}, and outside the group " is other again;
{\gmdqon K"onig\gmdqoff, then " is other again inside the group}.
% [T16] an active | whose meaning was set through \lccode
{\gmbaron $a|b$}
% [T14] braces from a remapped-catcode definition
\gmlbrace x\gmrbrace
% [T7] an explicit catcode change partway through a line, inside a group
{\catcode`\^=12 x^y} and $x^y$.
% [T8] \obeylines in a group
{\obeylines first line
second line}
% [T13] [T18] [T19] package-level results used in the body
\gmunderscore, \gmjoined, \gmifletter{a}, \gmifletter{1}, \gmplainties{no~tie}.
% [T5] active UTF-8 characters defined by \newunicodechar: ± and a non-breaking hyphen
Result 3 ± 1, non‑breaking.
% [T9] \uppercase with \expandafter and \romannumeral
Roman: \gmrnum{14}.
